incoming_learnings: Treat a protected reward route and an observation approach as separate from executable potion preparation. Before returning repeatedly, establish a jointly feasible test bank, isolated storage route and fresh-arrival handoff. Preserve mandatory pickup, unknown identities, hazard checks and explicit planner exhaustion.

review.review: The run ended in planner exhaustion with the hero alive at full health, not an observed death. At decision 365 (logs 1016–1017), potion preparation selected a return toward remembered bank 272 through doorway 218. Decision 366 (logs 1020–1021) abandoned that journey for nearby water 217; decision 367 returned through the doorway again. Changing visibility made the reactive choices alternate, eventually triggering navigation-loop recovery and the terminal stop at decision 421 (logs 1225–1227). Offline reconstruction matched the original selections through decision 366; the candidate first differs there and was not advanced using later observations. The proposed correction retains the admitted observation journey while rechecking its existing safety and resource gates. A new regression fails on original source and passes on the candidate; the full suite passes 2,417 tests with four skipped. This establishes continued preparation selection, not successful identification, collection, descent or improved survival.
review.learnings: Keep an admitted preparation-area return committed across doorway observations. Recheck each movement and require fresh bank and inventory-protection admission on arrival; remembered feasibility never authorizes drinking or collection credit.
